resolution: User confirmed the stair-top stick fix works in-game ('that seemed to be it'). The fix (commit 0f89be46a) replaces the velocity-dependent finite-difference slope estimate in clampUphillSurfaceSpeed — which death-spiralled the player to a standstill at a staircase crest — with a velocity-independent surface-gradient cap (max_surface_speed*normal_y). Verified the lingering game-physics test red (hollow ramp slab ascent) is pre-existing and unrelated: it fails on total 3D surface_speed including a rect step-up teleport, not the heightfield horizontal clamp my change touches, and my clamp value is algebraically identical to the old one on a uniform ramp. no-V8 loader builds clean.
